'''CZ-873''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He belonged to [[IsoTech]] and was stationned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].
